title: Norwegian Ham and Serrano Frittata
description: A rich and savory frittata filled with Norwegian ham and spicy serrano peppers, perfect for a hearty breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: 4 large eggs
ingredients.notes: Fresh eggs are best for this recipe.

ingredients.name: 6 slices of Norwegian ham
ingredients.notes: Look for thinly sliced, high-quality ham.

ingredients.name: 2 serrano peppers, diced
ingredients.notes: Wear gloves when handling hot peppers to avoid skin irritation.

ingredients.name: 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
ingredients.notes: A mild cheese like cheddar pairs well with the ham and peppers.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: A sprinkle of fresh parsley adds a bright, fresh flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper, to taste
ingredients.notes: Season to taste with salt and pepper.

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons butter
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality butter for the best flavor.

instructions: In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the diced serrano peppers and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Norwegian ham and cook until heated through, about 2-3 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the ham and pepper mixture in the skillet.
Sprinkle the shredded cheddar cheese over the top of the egg mixture.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Note: If you prefer a more well-done frittata, cook for an additional 5-10 minutes.
